headline: Cabinet approves proposal to relocate Secretariat to Sher-e-Bangla Nagar

members.title: Ekushey Book Fair 2027 to begin on 7 January
members.lead: The Amar Ekushey Book Fair 2027 will begin on 7 January and continue until 6 February. The information was announced in a press release issued by Bangla Academy on Sunday. According to the press release, a meeting with publishers’ representatives was held on the morning of 13 October at the Shaheed Munier Chowdhury Conference Room at Bangla Academy. . The dates for the 2027 fair were decided unanimously by the publishers’ representatives at the meeting held to discuss the organisation of the book fair. The meeting was chaired by Cultural Affairs Minister Nitai Roy Chowdhury. Cultural Affairs Ministry adviser Zahed Ur Rahman and ministry secretary Yasmin Begum were also present.

members.title: Cabinet approves proposal to relocate Secretariat to Sher-e-Bangla Nagar
members.lead: The Bangladesh Secretariat will be relocated from Abdul Gani Road in the capital to Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, the site of the former trade fair grounds. Government offices are expected to begin operating at the new location in 2029. The Cabinet approved the proposal to relocate the Secretariat at a meeting chaired by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman at the Secretariat on Sunday afternoon. . Cabinet Secretary Nasimul Ghani announced the decision at a press conference afterwards. The government had earlier taken a decision in principle to relocate the Secretariat at a meeting chaired by the prime minister. .Secretariat to be relocated to old trade fair venue, new road to be built. That meeting, held at the Prime Minister’s Office, was attended by senior officials from the Ministry of Housing and Public Works, the Public Works Department and the Department of Architecture. The following day, the Ministry of Housing and Public Works wrote to the Planning Commission requesting that a project to relocate the Secretariat be included in the Annual Development Programme (ADP).
